Phobos data
Au + Au  200 GeV
Charged particle invariant yield spectra in the 
region 0.2<y_pi<1.4 for various centrality bins  

Spectra were divided by Npart/2 and also by
a fit to the p+p charged particle spectrum

Only the most peripheral and most central bins
were shown in the paper.
